theorem NativeJets.native_copy_sum_uniformClass

    (hW : ∀ l n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ W l n x)
    (hmap : ∀ l n k x, x ∈ s.domain → (g l n).coordinates k x.2 ∈ Ω l n →
      ParticularWaveBounds.nativePoint (g l n) k x ∈ V.carrier (index l n))
